<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    members = set(row["members"]) | {row["owner_id"]}
    return row if actor["id"] in members or actor["tenant_id"] == row["tenant_id"] else None
